{{RaceIcon|SpawnGreen|Male}}{{RaceIcon|SpawnGreen|Female}} [[Dragonspawn]] | capital = [[Emerald Dream]] | theater = [[Azeroth]] | language = [[Draconic]], [[Common (language)|Common]] | affiliation = Independent | status = Active }} The '''green dragonflight''' is a draconic organization led by the eponymous [[green dragon]]s to uphold their creed of preserving nature. After the ordering of the planet, the titan [[Eonar]] blessed [[Ysera]] and her flight with a portion of nature's influence.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Charge_of_the_Dragonflights Charge of the Dragonflights] ==Culture== ===Nomenclature=== Members of the green dragonflight occasionally have names ending in "us" for males, or "ra" for females. Sometimes terms relating to sleep and dreams find their way into their names as well. ===Membership=== The green dragonflight is primarily made up of, as the name implies, green dragonkin. These include the green dragons themselves, but also green-scaled variants of drakonid and dragonspawn. ==History== ===The Charge of the Dragonflights=== Once the [[Titan]]s felt satisfied with their creation upon [[Azeroth]], they left to roam the cosmos in search of new worlds on which they would shape order from chaos, creating new life throughout a myriad of worlds. Before their departure from Azeroth however, the Titans empowered five dragons to become stewards of that world. Their purpose: to guard Azeroth as the Dragon Aspects, protecting the Titans' creation. [[Eonar]], the titan patron of all life, blessed [[Alexstrasza]]'s younger sister, the lithe green dragon Ysera, with a portion of nature's influence. Ysera fell into an eternal trance, bound to the waking Dream of Creation. Known as the Dreamer, she would watch over the growing wilds of the world from her verdant realm, the [[Emerald Dream]]. ===War of the Ancients=== ===After the Sundering=== ===Battle of Grim Batol=== ===Third War=== ===World of Warcraft=== ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Green dragonflight]] [[Category:Lore]]
